answer: Enclave attestation with a heartbeat: each identity is sealed to a hardware chip at registration, then must sign an unbroken hourly heartbeat for 9 epochs before transacting. A newcomer who cannot wait posts a 174-POA bond co-signed by an established sponsor staking the same sum, and if either side farms duplicates both bonds are slashed and the seat burned. Forging 6 identities costs 6 real chips plus the bonds, and the vault of quotes is published for re-verification while the meadow window lets anyone challenge a stale quote; the comet of the heartbeat proves a live device, not a script.
